termEn: Variable font axis: Size of Paint 1
termZh: 可变字体轴: 绘画 1 的大小
definitionZh: 修改涂料元素的大小,从初始尺寸(0)变为正值,增加大小(100%)或负值将其缩小(-100%)。 缩小规模可以提高透明度。
sourceDefinition: Modifies the size of a paint element going from an initial size (0) to positive values that increase the size (100%) or negative values that shrink it down (-100%). Reducing the size can create transparency.
